newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chuo Paperboard says to set loan loss reserve.
newsitem.headline: Chuo Paperboard says to set loan loss reserve.

text.p: Chuo Paperboard Co Ltd said on Friday it plans to set aside loan loss reserves of 12.42 billion yen for the half year to September 30, the first half of the 1996/97 business year.
The company forgave the same amount of loans to its affiliate Nippon Pack Co Ltd at the end of the half-year, a company spokesman said.
The loans account for 23.5 percent of Chuo Paperboard's total assets, the company's statement said.
Chuo Paperboard would sell off its stock holdings and land in eastern Japan to offset the loss, the spokesman said.
Chuo Paperboard and its group firms hold more than 50 percent of Nippon Pack, which makes and sells cardboard sheets and boxes, the spokesman said.
The spokesman said Nippon Pack would be dissolved and its operations were currently being transferred to a new firm.
